killedBy: hud: the pause exit is contextual (issue #323) leaves the match before opening the setup pane, through the paths that already exist
hud: every ending gets its own screen (issue #323) leaves the finished session and opens the Levels pane, in that order
why:
Opens the pane BEFORE leaving the match, so it is opened over a live session and `setState`'s unconditional close-all then takes it straight back down -- the pane the player asked for never appears. 

CONSOLIDATED from two entries (issue #566). The order used to be written out at both call sites, `handleChooseLevel` and `handleChangeSetup`, so each needed its own entry and each could be fixed without the other. `quitInto` puts the order in ONE place, so this single mutation breaks both callers and both their tests -- named above. That is a stronger guard than the pair it replaces, not a smaller one: a half-applied fix is no longer expressible. 

The retired sibling was `choose-level-opens-the-pane-over-the-finished-session`, whose scoped test is the second `killedBy` here.
